mcqs.question: Which of the following is a scheduling criterion used to evaluate the performance of a scheduling algorithm?
options: CPU Utilization
Throughput
Turnaround Time
Waiting Time

mcqs.question: Which scheduling criterion is most important in time-sharing systems?
options: CPU Utilization
Throughput
Turnaround Time
Response Time
mcqs.explanation: Response Time is important in time-sharing systems because it measures the time from the submission of a request to the first response, which is critical for user experience in such systems.
mcqs.evidence_quote: Response Time is time from request submission to first response. Important in time-sharing systems. [UNIT1_TOPIC2_S022]

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a characteristic of a short-term scheduler?
options: Selects the next process to execute on the CPU
Invoked very frequently (milliseconds)
Must be extremely fast
Often the only scheduler in a system
mcqs.explanation: A short-term scheduler (also known as a CPU scheduler) selects the next process to execute on the CPU, is invoked very frequently (milliseconds), and must be extremely fast to ensure timely execution. The correct answer is 'C' because it directly refers to a characteristic of a short-term scheduler as defined in the notes.
mcqs.evidence_quote: Short-term scheduler (CPU scheduler): • Selects the next process to execute on the CPU • Invoked very frequently (milliseconds) • Must be extremely fast • Often the only scheduler in a system. [UNIT1_TOPIC3_S016]

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a correct description of a context switch?
